newsitem.title: USA: U.S Northwest spot prods notionally flat on Friday.
newsitem.headline: U.S Northwest spot prods notionally flat on Friday.

text.p: Spot product prices in the U.S. Northwest stayed notionally flat Friday, with little direction from a subdued California market.
Conventional-grade California gasoline idled at 60/61 cents on Friday amid light trade after Thursday's steep fall in futures prices.
Seattle conventional regular gasoline stayed notionally unchanged at 60/61 cents a gallon.
Seattle low sulphur diesel remained 75/76 cents and jet fuel remained 75/76 cents a gallon.
